source_translation: Complete subtly tensioned cloth replaces symbolic stepped tears/gaps; substantial irregular E/W red fold group and NS2pixel width retained. Hidden thickness and supporting continuations are authored.

gate_and_items.required_states: isolated; four ends; two straights; four corners; four T junctions; crossing
gate_and_items.gate_scope: UsesGate is the native placement association, not an automatic shared paint group. Canvas has no PaintWith group. Do not add gate-neighbor flags absent source support. Preserve native gate art and state mechanics; gate is not a new ledger target.
gate_and_items.attached_items: Expose cardinal midpoint join/attachment anchors. Named-gate contact is a visual authoring proxy; wildcard PaintWith=* has source support in SingleTrack only. Unknown other item groups remain unknown.
gate_and_items.native_rules: Same exact blueprint joins. Nonempty PaintPart matches parts. Neighbor PaintWith=* joins SingleTrack. Equal PaintWith requires nonempty source group. MultiTrack wildcard check is guarded by nonempty source group. Preserve track-dependent behavior; do not repair it during art generation.
